Hi Kerry and AP team,

Welcome — glad to kick off vendor setup for Acme Health. To get you fully onboarded in our procurement and payment systems we need a few items so we can create a vendor record and issue POs: 

- Preferred payment method: ACH (EFT) or wire? If ACH, please provide an ACH authorization form and remittance email.
- Bank details (bank name, routing number, account number) — you may mask the account number in email and attach the completed ACH form as a secure PDF.
- Billing remit-to email and AP contact for invoice follow-up.
- Invoice submission method: email to invoices@redwoodinference.com, our AP portal, or via DocuSign/Ariba? Let us know the format you prefer and what fields you require on the invoice (PO number, invoice line items, tax id).
- Standard payment terms & earliest invoice date you expect (e.g., Net30, Net45).
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (if US entity).

I attached our vendor onboarding checklist, ACH authorization template, and a sample remittance email you can copy. If you can return the ACH form and W-9 within 5 business days, procurement will create the vendor record and we’ll issue the PO. Sean (cc'd) will own the PO issuance and Vivek will confirm payment terms & finance routing.

Thanks — please let me know if you prefer a short call to walk through the checklist.

Best,

Marissa Cole

- We can do ACH as our standard — will attach our completed ACH form and W-9 in the next message.

Marissa — FYI / guidance to provide to Acme: 

- Default payment terms: Net30 from invoice receipt unless a different term was negotiated on the SOW/contract. Net45 can be set for special arrangements but needs finance approval (ask customer to note request on vendor form).
- Preferred method: ACH (EFT) for standard payments. Wire is accepted for expedited payments but we charge a $25 remittance processing fee for wires (we can absorb for strategic deals but list it up front).
- Invoices must reference Redwood PO number. PO will be included in the email subject line and must also appear on the invoice PDF. That is how our AP automatically routes invoices.
- Remittance confirmations: Finance sends a remittance email to the vendor remit-to address on the vendor record on the day payment is issued; the email includes payment date, amount, and invoice numbers. Ask them to include remit-to email on invoices so their AR team receives the confirmation.
- Invoice submission: primary channel is invoices@redwoodinference.com. We support SFTP and Ariba for some partners; mention if Acme prefers SFTP and we can provision an account.

Procurement next steps: once we receive the completed ACH form + W-9, I will create the vendor record in Coupa and route for tax verification. Marissa — I can own the PO after vendor setup; plan to issue PO by 03/09 if we have the docs.

Sean Gallagher
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
